text: "This arch-like property of the diagonal frame not only opposes an alteration of position in a longitudinal direction, but also restate external pressure on the bottom, either from grounding or any other cause, because so impression can be made in its figure in these directions, without forcing the several parts of which it is composed into a shorter space.
